item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] St. Petersburg mayoral election will go to runoff in November
item.description: The St. Petersburg mayoral election will head to a runoff on Nov. 3 because neither incumbent Ken Welch nor former Florida Governor Charlie Crist reached 50% of the vote.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ryan Elijah ousts troubled Rep. Cory Mills in Florida's 7th District House primary
item.description: Former television news reporter Ryan Elijah won the Republican nomination for Florida’s 7th Congressional District, ousting scandal-plagued U.S. Rep. Cory Mills.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Angie Nixon is the projected winner of Florida's Democratic Senate primary, will take on Sen. Ashley Moody
item.description: Angie Nixon is the projected winner of Florida's Democratic Senate primary. XXX will take on Sen. Ashley Moody, who was appointed to the Senate seat in 2025.
